title: EU AI Act: Foundations, High-Risk Classification and Prohibited Practices

modules.title: Read the Act and frame an AI use case

concepts.name: Navigate the regulatory layers
concepts.assessment: Locate the layer that answers a stated regulatory question.

concepts.name: Risk
concepts.assessment: Distinguish probability of harm from severity of harm.

concepts.name: Support for AI literacy
concepts.assessment: Identify a measure supporting staff literacy in a stated context.

concepts.name: AI system
concepts.assessment: Identify which element of the statutory definition needs evidence.

concepts.name: General-purpose AI model
concepts.assessment: Distinguish a model from a system in a supplied architecture description.

concepts.name: Intended purpose
concepts.assessment: Identify the provider-stated purpose in a document excerpt.

concepts.name: Describe a use case
concepts.assessment: Select the missing fact in a system-purpose-decision description.

concepts.name: Profiling
concepts.assessment: Identify automated evaluation of personal aspects against the incorporated definition.

concepts.name: Provider
concepts.assessment: Identify the provider from development and market/service facts.

concepts.name: Deployer
concepts.assessment: Identify who uses a system under its authority.

concepts.name: Look up another actor
concepts.assessment: Select the applicable actor definition for a supply-chain fact.

concepts.name: Territorial scope
concepts.assessment: Identify the connecting fact in a described cross-border arrangement.

concepts.name: Scope exclusions
concepts.assessment: Locate the relevant exclusion and its limiting conditions.

concepts.name: Other law continues to apply
concepts.assessment: Explain why an AI Act classification alone does not settle a data-law question.

concepts.name: Authentic acts and consolidated documents
concepts.assessment: Choose the source that establishes an enacted amendment.

concepts.name: Follow a legal locator
concepts.assessment: Locate an article, point or annex using its reference.

concepts.name: Status of guidance
concepts.assessment: Distinguish adopted non-binding guidance from a consultation draft.
concepts.source_locator: Commission definition guidance publication; Article 6 draft guidance publication

concepts.name: Entry into force
concepts.assessment: Distinguish entry into force from a provision-specific application date.

concepts.name: Find an application date
concepts.assessment: Select the applicable date for a specified provision and classification route.

concepts.name: Check transitional treatment
concepts.assessment: Identify the facts needed to apply a specified existing-system transition.

concepts.name: Classification does not establish permission
concepts.assessment: Flag a possible prohibition for later examination without declaring it proven.

concepts.name: Initial assessment evidence
concepts.assessment: Select the missing source, scope, purpose or actor fact in an initial assessment.

concepts.name: High-risk classification
concepts.assessment: Distinguish a classification result from a compliance certificate.

concepts.name: Two independent classification routes
concepts.assessment: Select the product or listed-use route to investigate from supplied facts.

concepts.name: Safety component
concepts.assessment: Identify the intended safety function of a described component.

concepts.name: Exclusively non-safety functions
concepts.assessment: Explain why a supplied exclusively non-safety function is not a safety component.

concepts.name: Health and safety consequences of failure
concepts.assessment: Identify the fact that activates the failure or malfunction rule.

concepts.name: Trace an Annex I instrument
concepts.assessment: Locate the instrument and section for a supplied product.
concepts.source_locator: Annex I, Sections A and B

concepts.name: Sector-specific scope limits
concepts.assessment: Identify which AI Act provisions apply to a supplied Section B product.

concepts.name: Third-party conformity assessment
concepts.assessment: Distinguish a required third-party route from voluntary certification.

concepts.name: Test the conformity-assessment condition
concepts.assessment: Identify the sector-law evidence needed to establish a mandatory assessment route.

concepts.name: Assessment solely for other risks
concepts.assessment: Identify when the added non-health/safety-risk limit applies.

concepts.name: Complete a product-route assessment
concepts.assessment: Apply both product-route conditions to an embedded or independently marketed system.

concepts.name: Classification guidance
concepts.assessment: Distinguish the guidance mandate from a change to the legal test.

concepts.name: Delegated changes to classification
concepts.assessment: Identify the legal mechanism for a proposed change to a condition or listed use.

concepts.name: Protection constraint on changes
concepts.assessment: Identify why a proposed delegated change needs evidence about protection.

concepts.name: Biometric data
concepts.assessment: Identify the technical processing and personal-characteristic facts relevant to the definition.

concepts.name: Identification and verification
concepts.assessment: Distinguish identity discovery from confirmation of a claimed identity.

concepts.name: Remote biometric identification
concepts.assessment: Identify the absence of active involvement in an identification scenario.

concepts.name: Emotion recognition system
concepts.assessment: Identify inference of emotion or intention from biometric data.

concepts.name: Biometric categorisation system
concepts.assessment: Identify categorisation from biometric data and the ancillary-service definition boundary.

concepts.name: Education access use
concepts.assessment: Match access, admission or assignment facts to Annex III(3)(a).

concepts.name: Learning-outcome assessment use
concepts.assessment: Match an evaluation or learning-steering function to Annex III(3)(b).

concepts.name: Education-level assessment use
concepts.assessment: Match a level-assessment function to Annex III(3)(c).

concepts.name: Examination monitoring use
concepts.assessment: Match prohibited-behaviour monitoring during tests to Annex III(3)(d).

concepts.name: Recruitment and selection use
concepts.assessment: Match a hiring function to Annex III(4)(a), including targeted advertising.

concepts.name: Worker-management use
concepts.assessment: Match a work-related decision, task allocation or performance-monitoring function to Annex III(4)(b).

concepts.name: Separate platform functions
concepts.assessment: Assign separate source locators to distinct functions within one platform.

concepts.name: Infrastructure safety use
concepts.assessment: Match a safety function and infrastructure category to Annex III(2).

concepts.name: Creditworthiness use
concepts.assessment: Distinguish creditworthiness assessment from the stated financial-fraud exception.

concepts.name: Life and health insurance use
concepts.assessment: Match a risk-assessment or pricing function for natural persons to Annex III(5)(c).

concepts.name: Public assistance use
concepts.assessment: Match an eligibility, grant, reduction, revocation or reclaiming decision to Annex III(5)(a).

concepts.name: Emergency-services use
concepts.assessment: Match a call classification, dispatch priority or patient-triage function to Annex III(5)(d).

concepts.name: Law enforcement
concepts.assessment: Identify the authority and purpose facts relevant to the law-enforcement definitions.

concepts.name: Look up a law-enforcement use
concepts.assessment: Locate the exact Annex III(6) point matching a supplied function.

concepts.name: Look up a migration or border use
concepts.assessment: Locate the exact Annex III(7) point and the travel-document verification boundary.

concepts.name: Justice and dispute-resolution use
concepts.assessment: Match a concrete adjudication-support function to Annex III(8)(a).

concepts.name: Election-influence use
concepts.assessment: Distinguish direct voting influence from the stated administrative/logistical boundary.

concepts.name: Significance-of-harm gateway
concepts.assessment: Identify missing evidence about risk of harm under Article 6(3).

concepts.name: Influence on the decision
concepts.assessment: Identify how a supplied system materially affects a decision outcome.

concepts.name: Narrow procedural task
concepts.assessment: Test whether the facts support Article 6(3)(a) without bypassing the gateway.

concepts.name: Previously completed human activity
concepts.assessment: Test the prior-completion condition in Article 6(3)(b).

concepts.name: Patterns with proper human review
concepts.assessment: Identify the fact that defeats a proposed Article 6(3)(c) justification.

concepts.name: Preparatory task
concepts.assessment: Test a preparatory-task justification against the gateway.

concepts.name: Profiling override within Annex III
concepts.assessment: Explain why profiling prevents the paragraph 3 derogation for a listed system.

concepts.name: Document a non-high-risk assessment
concepts.assessment: Select the missing reason or evidence in an Article 6(4) assessment.

concepts.name: Registration after a paragraph 3 conclusion
concepts.assessment: Identify who registers and when under Article 49(2).
concepts.source_locator: Article 6(4); Article 49(2), (4); Annex VIII Section B

concepts.name: Documentation requested by an authority
concepts.assessment: Identify the duty to supply the assessment documentation on request.

concepts.name: Explain a classification conclusion
concepts.assessment: Choose a reasoned classification conclusion or request for missing evidence in contrasting cases.

concepts.name: Market, service and use triggers
concepts.assessment: Identify the action regulated by a supplied prohibition.

concepts.name: Read a prohibition as a test
concepts.assessment: Identify the missing element rather than infer a ban from a technology label.

concepts.name: Prohibition and classification
concepts.assessment: Explain why high-risk duties cannot cure a prohibited practice.

concepts.name: Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive technique
concepts.assessment: Identify the relevant technique in a non-graphic fictional case.

concepts.name: Manipulation causal chain
concepts.assessment: Identify a missing link between technique, impaired choice, changed decision and significant harm.

concepts.name: Specified vulnerability
concepts.assessment: Identify the specified age, disability or social/economic vulnerability.

concepts.name: Exploitation and significant harm
concepts.assessment: Test whether the stated vulnerability is exploited to distort behaviour with the required harm.

concepts.name: Social scoring and its consequences
concepts.assessment: Identify which consequence condition is or is not supported by a scoring case.

concepts.name: Individual offending-risk ban
concepts.assessment: Identify a solely profiling/personality-based prediction of offending.

concepts.name: Fact-based human assessment boundary
concepts.assessment: Identify the objective, verifiable, directly linked facts required by the stated boundary.

concepts.name: Assess a harmful-decision practice
concepts.assessment: Identify the decisive prohibition element or missing fact in a persuasion, scoring or prediction case.

concepts.name: Untargeted scraping
concepts.assessment: Identify the indiscriminate collection feature in a supplied case.

concepts.name: Facial database creation or expansion
concepts.assessment: Test the database purpose, image source and untargeted-scraping facts.

concepts.name: Workplace and education emotion ban
concepts.assessment: Identify whether the emotion-inference purpose and setting match the prohibition.

concepts.name: Medical or safety reasons
concepts.assessment: Identify the purpose evidence needed for the stated exception.

concepts.name: Listed sensitive-attribute inference
concepts.assessment: Identify a listed attribute inferred by individual biometric categorisation.

concepts.name: Labelling, filtering and law-enforcement boundary
concepts.assessment: Identify why the precise stated boundary must be checked rather than assumed.

concepts.name: Consent to intimate generation or manipulation
concepts.assessment: Identify the missing consent element in a neutral fictional case.

concepts.name: Limited manipulation boundary
concepts.assessment: Identify whether increased exposure or changed activity defeats the added boundary.

concepts.name: Locate incorporated definitions
concepts.assessment: Locate the incorporated material/performance definition without graphic examples.

concepts.name: Generation or manipulation prohibition
concepts.assessment: Identify the covered generation/manipulation purpose and a national-law question.

concepts.name: Reasonably foreseeable misuse
concepts.assessment: Distinguish intended purpose from reasonably foreseeable contrary use.

concepts.name: Market/service test for the new prohibitions
concepts.assessment: Identify the intended-purpose branch or the reproducibility-and-safeguards branch.

concepts.name: Use test for the new prohibitions
concepts.assessment: Identify the deployer purpose that triggers the new use prohibition.

concepts.name: Real-time remote biometric identification
concepts.assessment: Distinguish real-time identification, including limited short delays, from post-identification.

concepts.name: Publicly accessible space
concepts.assessment: Identify access by an undetermined number of persons regardless of ownership.

concepts.name: Limited law-enforcement objectives
concepts.assessment: Match a stated objective to Article 5(1)(h), checking Annex II and the sentence threshold where relevant.

concepts.name: Necessity and proportionality
concepts.assessment: Identify the evidence needed about no-use harm and effects on affected persons.

concepts.name: Target and limits of use
concepts.assessment: Identify a temporal, geographic or personal limit missing from a proposed use.

concepts.name: Impact assessment and registration
concepts.assessment: Distinguish the completed impact assessment from the urgency rule for registration.

concepts.name: Prior binding authorisation
concepts.assessment: Identify the authorising body and evidential requirement in a supplied procedure.

concepts.name: Urgent authorisation request
concepts.assessment: Apply the without-undue-delay and latest-24-hour request conditions to a supplied timeline.

concepts.name: Consequences of refusal
concepts.assessment: Identify the required immediate stop and deletion response to refusal.

concepts.name: Locate national authorisation rules
concepts.assessment: Identify the Member State rule needed to know whether an objective can be authorised.

concepts.name: Notification after each use
concepts.assessment: Identify the two authorities to notify without sensitive operational data.

concepts.name: Annual reporting chain
concepts.assessment: Distinguish authority reporting from Commission aggregate publication.

concepts.name: Check another applicable prohibition
concepts.assessment: Identify why an Article 5 boundary does not settle compliance with another EU law.

concepts.name: No adverse legal decision solely on identification output
concepts.assessment: Identify a decision made solely on a real-time identification output that produces an adverse legal effect.

concepts.name: Biometric-practice synthesis
concepts.assessment: Choose a reasoned conclusion for a scraping, emotion, categorisation or remote-identification case.

concepts.name: Final prohibition and classification assessment
concepts.assessment: Choose a defensible, dated conclusion combining prohibition screening with classification.
